_note: One-joint system-ID trials for ctrl_scripts/sysid_logger.py. The trial name is m<motor_id>_<pattern>.
Offsets are in degrees, relative to the pose each joint holds at startup, in the hardware joint convention.
If one_sided is true, the offsets point into the joint's range. The knee rests on its 0 rad limit, so it only flexes.
Every target goes through the deployed path: 0.95 soft limits, joint clamps, the max_vel_rad_s slew, the torque guard caps.
Joint names are mirrored: motors 1-5 (left_*) are the PHYSICAL RIGHT leg, motors 6-10 (right_*) the physical left leg.
fit and holdout tags pick which trials fit the model and which validate it.
